rule: A diagonal-symmetric plaid contains objects (8-connected components) of a hidden colour. Some objects have been repainted 8 as templates. Every object of the template's underlying colour with exactly the template's shape and orientation is repainted 8. Other colours and transposed or different shapes stay unchanged.
scope: Recover the underlying colour of marked components from transpose symmetry or repeated clean lines, then recolour exact same-orientation components of that colour. Plaid layer constructions with optional mirrored motif patches, random squares 12..30, exact requested 10..30, one to three distinct template shapes.

authored_scope: Supported: square plaids of side 12..30 by default (10..30 via size). Sizes outside 17..27 are synthetic extensions. Two layer schemes are supported, 3-layer [0,a,b] and 4-layer [0,a,b,a], with {a,b}={1,2}, or a caller-supplied palette following the same convention. Blocks are 1..3 wide. Optional random motif tiles are mirrored by transpose into off-diagonal blocks. Each scene has 1..3 templates of distinct shapes of 2..6 cells. Fixtures are rebuilt from explicit types, palette, patches and template anchors. Not supported in random mode: templates whose hidden colour can only be recovered via clean-row/column matching (like the test's self-mirrored L, which is reproduced only through explicit arguments); symmetric diagonal-block motif tiles; non-square or non-symmetric grids.
authored_constraints: Grid is exactly transpose-symmetric before templates are applied; patches are written together with their transposes.
The object colour differs from every other layer colour, and 8 never appears in the palette or in tiles.
Every template is a whole component of the object colour, and its shape occurs at least twice, so the output is never identity.
Templates have distinct shapes and are distinct same-colour components, so they are never 8-adjacent to one another.
No template cell's transpose lies in any template, so the mirror cell always reveals the hidden colour unambiguously.
At least one object-colour component of a non-template shape remains as a distractor; mirrored copies give transposed-shape distractors naturally.
Separators bound every block, so object components and motif cells stay inside their block.
Partial controls are validated: patches and templates require explicit types; size and num_templates must agree with explicit arguments.
